image_description: A top-down view of a Dungeness crab (Cancer magister) positioned centrally on a light beige background. The crab features a broad, oval-shaped carapace with a reddish-pink to purplish-brown hue and lighter mottling. It has five pairs of legs extending laterally, with the first pair modified into large, robust claws (chelipeds) that have dark tips. The eyes are small and stalked, protruding from the anterior margin of the carapace. There is faint, illegible text in the upper right corner of the background.

artifact_observations.reasoning: Faint, distorted characters resembling 'Anchovia' or similar text appear in the background. They are not part of the subject but suggest an AI artifact or a scan of a labeled diagram where the label bled into the generation.
Slight softness and lack of sharp definition at the points where the legs meet the background, suggesting minor edge bleeding or fusion typical of generative models.
